name: Dolfines S.A.
summary: Dolfines SA provides offshore drilling in France and internationally. It offers various services, including inspections of dynamically positioned semi-submersible units, risk studies, and human factors engineering studies, as well as consulting services in the wind and solar energy sector. The company was formerly known as Dietswell S.A. and changed its name to Dolfines SA in October 2020. Dolfines SA was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Montigny-Le-Bretonneux, France.
